Yaeno Muteki was set to run in the Arima 
Kinen. A showcase event introducing the 
participating Umamusume was scheduled for 
the afternoon.

Oguri Cap was also there, looking down the 
entire time. Her form had slumped lately, 
leading to a string of uncharacteristic 
performances.

Yaeno Muteki grew irritated by the 
disheartened state of Oguri Cap. The 
moment she stepped onto the track during 
the event, she suddenly sprinted at full 
power.

When Oguri Cap looked up at the stir in 
the crowd, Yaeno Muteki scolded her, 
telling her that drawing power from the 
cheering was what Oguri Cap's running was 
all about.

"That's why you should lift your head and 
feel their cheers. Oguri Cap came back to 
her senses at those words, her fighting 
spirit fully rekindled."
